jruby.about: JRuby 10.1.2.0 compiled to JavaScript by TeaVM 0.16.0 (the JS build, not wasm-gc), for the JRuby and Ruboto lessons

patch.about: the lessons' build source on top of base: git format-patch of three commits (local branch ruboto-sim, 38898b4 + 997b339 + a38020b in the builder's checkout), apply with git am; the result's tree is the one named here

jruby.changes: json gem 2.21.2 Java ext (require 'json'), jackson-core 2.18.2, lesson.Quakes, ZXing core 3.5.4, AtomicInteger/ConcurrentHashMap, TCharset aliases + isSupported, TCharConversionException; the Ruboto lesson's Android stand-ins (android-src/: android.*, org.ruboto.*, org.chunkybacon.sim.Device); a fix of TeaVM's ReferenceQueue typing in teavm-plugin (QueuedReferences: without it JRuby's proxy cache failed after a GC with 'TypeError: d.bfq is not a function')
jruby.build: git clone https://github.com/Largo/jruby-teavm && git -C jruby-teavm checkout 730d53b && git -C jruby-teavm am <this repo>/tools/jruby-teavm-lesson.patch, then setup/fetch.sh (inputs, incl. jackson-core 2.18.2 and ZXing core 3.5.4 from Maven Central, SHA-256-checked) and ./build.sh (about 3 min on the Hetzner box, never on the 1-core Linode). The pinned jruby.js is that build, from a fresh clone (2026-10-19; on 2026-10-17 a rebuild of the JRuby lesson's patch was bit-identical). An incremental build in another checkout gave the same code with other generated short names: TeaVM numbers classes in the order javac gets the sources, which follows the directory listing. stdlib.zip: the same 1376 entries byte for byte in every build, only its zip timestamps differ (so its pin is the build that shipped first)
